purpose: Evidence-linked authoring table for five existing assets; not a production configuration or biomechanical certification

conventions.froude: Fr = v^2/(g*h); h is a single calibrated standing hip-height reference per profile, not each frame's pelvis height
conventions.speed: v = sqrt(Fr*g*h); withheld until calibrated h is supplied
conventions.duty_factor: Time one foot contacts ground / same-foot stride-cycle duration
conventions.stride: One foot touchdown to its next touchdown; do not silently substitute step period
conventions.stance_width: Full left-to-right stance-lane separation, not per-side offset
conventions.toe_clearance: Lowest articulated toe/pad surface at midswing over a rigid flat plane; not skeleton origin
conventions.angles: Anatomical frame and reference pose required; no source Euler angles copied as artistic bone rotations
conventions.evidence: E1 values are proposed experimental targets/ranges, not measured performance or confidence intervals
conventions.feasibility: Search fields are coupled; combinations need independent contact, geometry and dynamics checks

sources.citation: Cuff et al. (2022), Walking—and Running and Jumping—with Dinosaurs and their Cousins
sources.locator: PDF pp. 6–8, Table 1; p. 11, Table 2; pp. 14–15, Fig. 7
sources.supports: Archosaur gait mechanics; grounded versus aerial running; foot-model limitations; Coelophysis tail/stance coupling.
sources.limit: Not a parameter dataset for the five target taxa. Table 1 is representative extant walking trials, not joint ROM. Table 2 contains none of these five taxa.

sources.citation: Bishop, Cuff & Hutchinson (2021), How to build a dinosaur
sources.locator: Printed pp. 3, 8–13, 18–26; PDF pages are one higher
sources.supports: Joint-frame calibration; reference pose versus habitual pose; mass/COM/inertia; osteological mobility and uncertainty.
sources.limit: Coelophysis case study is static inverse mid-stance analysis, not a full locomotion controller. Its 33 MTUs and force assumptions are model-specific.

sources.citation: Sellers et al. (2017), Investigating the running abilities of Tyrannosaurus rex
sources.locator: pp. 4–7 model; pp. 9–13 results, gait definitions and limitations
sources.supports: Stress constraints can exclude fast aerial gaits; grounded running differs from aerial running.
sources.limit: A particular 7,206.7 kg adult T. rex model. Not a universal speed, stress limit, or no-running rule for other taxa.

sources.citation: Bishop et al. (2018), Cancellous bone and theropod dinosaur locomotion, Part II
sources.supports: Characteristic posture estimated from bone fabric; quasi-static chicken validation and its limitations.
sources.limit: Not Part III. A characteristic posture is not a full gait. Uniform 2 BW actuator forces and large MTP reserve are modeling conveniences, not dinosaur strengths.

sources.citation: Yun (2024), Mandibular force profiles of Alioramini
sources.locator: Introduction, p. 2: MPC-D 100/1844; cites Brusatte et al. (2009)
sources.supports: Reports 369 kg estimate for the juvenile Alioramus altai holotype.
sources.limit: Literature mass anchor, not a measurement of our GLB and not an adult mass. No locomotion calibration provided.
sources.kind: External primary research; mass attribution to earlier study

sources.citation: Makovicky, Kobayashi & Currie (2004), Ornithomimosauria, The Dinosauria
sources.supports: Gallimimus/ornithomimid limb and foot morphology; ornithomimid loss of hallux; long distal elements.
sources.limit: Morphology, not measured Gallimimus speeds or joint limits. Do not apply its pre-2014 Deinocheirus account as current reconstruction.

sources.citation: Marsh & Rowe (2020), A comprehensive anatomical and phylogenetic evaluation of Dilophosaurus wetherilli
sources.locator: Author-institution publication abstract, skeletal and phylogenetic conclusions
sources.supports: Large-bodied early theropod; the study does not recover it as a coelophysoid; differentiated axial anatomy.
sources.limit: No species gait timeseries or maximum speed in the accessed abstract. Coelophysis is a methodological comparator, not the same body.
sources.kind: External primary research abstract hosted by author institution

sources.citation: Sullivan (2006), A taxonomic review of the Pachycephalosauridae
sources.supports: Prenocephale holotype Z. Pal. MgD-I/104 includes nearly complete skull and partial postcranium; ornithischian identity.
sources.limit: Not a dynamic gait model or head-impact performance calibration. Partial postcranium is not absence of all postcranial evidence.

sources.citation: Lee et al. (2014), Resolving the long-standing enigmas of a giant ornithomimosaur Deinocheirus mirificus
sources.locator: Abstract; specimens MPC-D 100/127 and 100/128; supplementary description
sources.supports: Heavily built non-cursorial body, short hindlimbs, broad-tipped pedal unguals, distinctive axial anatomy.
sources.limit: Does not establish the proposed duty factors or a biological prohibition of all aerial movement. Numeric mass is not extracted from the accessible abstract/supplement here.

sources.citation: Dececchi et al. (2020), The fast and the frugal
sources.locator: Methods: Relative leg length and max speed; Postural considerations
sources.supports: Dimensionless speed scaling and explicit hip-height proxy assumptions; cautions on simple limb indices.
sources.limit: Froude-based speed is not independent validation or a universal gait classifier. Do not use 0.8 × limb length as a compulsory standing height.
